description: This file contains function prototypes, macro guards, and licensing information for the BEEP Request Object API. It declares creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions related to the BEEP request object.

methods.name: BeepCreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a BEEP request object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BeepReqoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the BEEP Request Object.

methods.name: BeepReqoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the BEEP Request Object instance.

methods.name: BeepReqoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the BEEP Request Object.
